description:
Hash two inputs with the same algorithm and compare them in constant time. Useful for verifying file integrity.

Returns: JSON { match: boolean } computed with a constant-time comparison.
Example input: {"a":"hello","b":"hello","algorithm":"sha256"}
On error, includes hint: `algorithm` (optional, default sha256) must be one of: md5, sha1, sha256, sha384, sha512.
name: hash_compare
title: Hash compare
